FREMONT, Calif., July 22, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Enovix Corporation (Nasdaq: ENVX) (“Enovix”), a developer and manufacturer of advanced lithium-ion batteries, including proprietary silicon-anode architectures, today announced it will report financial results for the second quarter of 2026 on Wednesday, August 12, 2026, after the close of the market.


Enovix will hold a live audio-only call at 2:00 PM PT / 5:00 PM ET on August 12, 2026, to discuss the company’s recent business updates, commercialization progress, operational milestones, and financial results. To join the call, participants must use the following link to register:[https://enovix-q2-2026.open-exchange.net/](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=KbCtlQSg6byOzt_0ZY6NcaBmhi_PXLBzOpQmj5G0ng_4FYDgoBstkPD2WmlAL61ejkqoJECa3HvS7fMCpmyj68JW4jwU3HJqW3NhcqgGyof6RGbGnN2kpeTh_FNnypdhX1B68ovqoRjzKh6iL-aGEg==) This link will also be available via the Investor Relations section of Enovix’s website at[https://ir.enovix.com](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=KbCtlQSg6byOzt_0ZY6Ncb7RtYKRTShRBAgppsuGnj8p6yWXxZrz6c4zWxgE-XAquEqeq45bMwyxSoLdrPymgGTyb1vdICvMM9PL-j7-W55yp2K_YYWEGEvDidkYBRpyKlaGmoVYXlSJVl6LQl4LFng0Mzd3bzd0BBpJQFd96EIG6nkAhBD4OuzNGU2IQQgQoBTaFDlPs6lnITcSSkb60kaMJ1c82uwvWck5QKB_3n6_2rJAKeNFERO33MjVvy6ahPYVBhJ7sqvZ41EBzn95aQ==) . Investors may submit questions on the registration page that they would like addressed on the call by Enovix management.


**About Enovix**


Enovix develops and manufactures advanced lithium-ion batteries, including proprietary silicon-anode architectures for smartphones, smart eyewear, defense, industrial and emerging edge-AI applications. Its silicon-anode architecture enables higher energy density and performance in space-constrained devices while maintaining safety and reliability, supporting commercialization across consumer and industrial markets.


Enovix is headquartered in Silicon Valley with facilities in India, South Korea and Malaysia, serving customers globally. For more information visit[https://enovix.com](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=KbCtlQSg6byOzt_0ZY6NcZLy2ZuglB1UQMdbzRGgo3zXounKlqW0F4USbuDOGkDYgDMr8Nmc4jvbvoJZp0yXLQ==) and follow us on[LinkedIn](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=F4_CzvllZPOedldrkws_V-gDPYzkMIcl5cQg9JO_r0KiKO1G1-1AIMlJ5vwcZ_UlM8axDT5kI0FnRmEcMkYsWaE0rg4bK84pz--MyU6rIsRDqEpqJcu8rwJ3geliFEyB) .
